current_answer: As checked on October 9, 2026, Rockstar, Take-Two, PlayStation, and Xbox still list Grand Theft Auto VI for November 19, 2026 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S; no new official date change was found. Xbox chief strategy officer Matthew Ball said the game will not stream exclusively or to PC, correcting the reported launch-day PC route. No native PC version, date, or window is announced. Whether any cloud service or non-PC device will support the game remains unspecified; this correction is not a release-readiness signal.

catalogue_card.question: Can GTA 6 still reach PC through Xbox Cloud Gaming?
catalogue_card.text: No PC stream, says Xbox’s chief strategy officer. The November 19 PS5 and Xbox Series X|S date still stands; native PC timing and other cloud-device support remain unknown.
